Issue Description: strdup can return null, but the pointer is passed directly to t2_event_s without validation, risking undefined behavior in downstream handling.
Suggested Fix: Check strdup result before use and provide a safe fallback path when allocation fails.

Issue Description: Unbounded sprintf writes into a fixed-size buffer and may overflow if formatting assumptions change.
Suggested Fix: Replace sprintf with snprintf and validate return value against buffer size.

Issue Description: The active config descriptor acquired from libusb_get_active_config_descriptor is not released on success, leaking libusb resources.
Suggested Fix: Call libusb_free_config_descriptor(config_desc) after finishing use of config_desc.

Issue Description: Uses unbounded sprintf into a fixed-size stack buffer in device matching logic.
Suggested Fix: Use snprintf with buffer-size checks before comparing device names.

Issue Description: The success check is inverted: error-handling and parent-discovery logic executes on failure, while success path logs a failure warning.
Suggested Fix: Flip the condition to run parent discovery only when status indicates success and keep warning for actual failures.

Issue Description: Uses unbounded sprintf when matching device names in BindDriver path.
Suggested Fix: Use snprintf with explicit bounds checking.

Issue Description: Uses unbounded sprintf when matching device names in UnbindDriver path.
Suggested Fix: Use snprintf with explicit bounds checking.
